messages:
maya: kicking off the API v2 header rollout in the 03:00 UTC window. deploy-bot scheduled to flip gateway flag at +5m. please confirm mobile SDK pin and proxy behavior.
jorge: noted. which header exactly are we enforcing? X-Client-Api-Version or X-Api-Version?
alexa: X-Api-Version is the one client SDKs already send in 2.0. mobile iOS might be on the older lib that uses X-Client-Api-Version. we should tolerate both for a week.
samir: can we add a temporary shim at the edge to map X-Client-Api-Version -> X-Api-Version? quick middleware in envoy.
maya: yes, plan A: envoy header_map config for 7 days then remove. Plan B: if traffic spike or errors > 2% rollback to v1 routing.
sre-ops: watchlist:  latency p50/p95 on gateway, error rate to /v2 routes, and 502s from runtimes. alert if v2 error rate > 1.5% for 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @maya at 2024-09-19 03:00:00 UTC. jobs: gateway-flip, canary-traffic 5%, notify #incidents on threshold.
jorge: quick compatibility smoke: curl example for clients that need to opt-in:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX" -H "X-Api-Version: 2" https://api.redwood.dev/v2/generate
```
if header missing they should still hit /v1 until shim expires.
alexa: mobile SDK owners — @samir can you coordinate an urgent patch to send X-Api-Version for next rollout? also update release notes for breaking header deprecation.
samir: will open a tiny PR to bump header, and add runtime guard to not overwrite explicit headers from proxies. ETA 4h.
maya: runbook: if clients receive model mismatch or schema errors, switch gateway back to legacy routing flag: `gateway.api_version.default=v1`. rollback window 15m.
sre-ops: we'll keep an eye on active connections and KV cache warmup. if we see regen storm > 300QPS on kv-miss, abort.
deploy-bot: canary progress: 1/4 hosts rotated -> 5% traffic -> no errors in first 2m :white_check_mark:
jorge: saw one iOS client hit 400 missing header in logs but shim mapped it, no client-visible error. please add a small metric for "shim_mapped_header".
alexa: added metric request to telemetry board. Maya, add to release notes: 1) header shim present for 7 days, 2) SDK patch required, 3) rollback criteria.
maya: done. release-notes draft posted: https://go/redwood/release-notes/patch-20240919 (internal)
samir: PR merged to mobile main, CI green. I'll tag mobile-1.2.3 with the header change. request ops to schedule a patch rollout to users who auto-update.
sre-ops: prepping dashboards. creating alert `v2-route-errors > 1.5% 5m` and `kv-miss-regen > 300qps`.
deploy-bot: canary progress: 2/4 hosts rotated -> 10% traffic -> 4m no regressions.
maya: if we don't see any regressions by 15m, promote to full rollout. thumbs? :+1:
jorge: +1.
alexa: +1, mobile owners are on watch.
samir: +1.
maya: promoting now. deploy-bot please run full flip with gradual roll.
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: fanout to remaining hosts over 12m. will post final status.
(10m later)
deploy-bot: rollout complete. metrics: p50 +3ms, p95 +18ms, v2-route-errors 0.4%. shim_mapped_header metric: 1.8% of requests mapped.
sre-ops: looks healthy. leaving retention monitors on for 24h.
maya: leaving shim removal task for 2024-09-26. if any important customers report problems we will extend. closing thread in 24h. :white_check_mark:
